blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police arrested six people in five separate anti-drug operations across the Caraga region on Saturday. In a statement on Sunday, the Police Regional Office-Caraga (PRO-13) said its operating units confiscated 20.2494 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P137,695.92. The anti-drug operations were conducted in Butuan City, Barobo in Surigao del Sur, Dapa in Surigao del Norte, and Talacogon in Agusan del Sur by police in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-Caraga.
